# Project templates

Copy and complete these templates for each lab run. Replace all prompts with actual information and store sensitive artefacts in restricted storage.

- [Change plan and rollback](change-plan.md)
- [Security assessment report](security-assessment-report.md)
- [Evidence register](evidence-register.md)

## Result status definitions
- **Pass:** test performed and acceptance criterion met.
- **Fail:** test performed and criterion not met.
- **Not tested:** no reliable test was performed.
- **Not applicable:** control does not apply, with rationale.
- **Exception:** authorised deviation exists, with owner and review date.

Never use illustrative SVG terminal images as proof that a live host passed. Capture genuine output and redact secrets, customer details, personal identifiers, and infrastructure details where appropriate.
